name: moltguard
description: Zero Trust security for OpenClaw agents. The OGR-protocol enforcement point (agent-hook altitude): every tool call is checked against your OpenGuardrails Runtime before it executes — block, allow, or hold for phone approval.

server.description: OpenGuardrails Runtime base URL (or set OGR_SERVER).

enrollToken.description: Tenant enroll token from your runtime (or set OGR_ENROLL_TOKEN).

principal.description: Human principal this agent acts for, e.g. you@corp (or OGR_PRINCIPAL).

failOpenWhenUnconfigured.description: When moltguard has no runtime configured, allow tool calls (default true) instead of blocking.

heartbeatIntervalS.description: How often to heartbeat the runtime (went-dark detection + kill switch).

enrollToken.label: Enroll Token
enrollToken.help: One-time tenant enroll token from the runtime console.

principal.label: Principal
principal.help: Who this agent acts for — shown on approvals.
